description: Delegates wake-word detection to a shared remote host over a persistent WebSocket connection (satellite architecture): streams raw PCM frames to the server and receives detection events back, instead of running any model locally.
notes: Remote-dependent, like the Azure/Google cloud fighters: requires a reachable ovos-ww-plugin-server host (default ws://localhost:8338); optional 'api_key' config sends 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. No local model weights. Streams raw PCM frames but is not tagged 'stream' capability here since that tag is reserved by tests/test_ww_stream.py for the openwakeword-/microwakeword-/precise-onnx- families.
